original: Access to the Llŷn Coast Path is generally open via public rights of way, though local segments may have seasonal management. Distinguish between general coastal access and specific parking or accommodation requirements by checking current status with the National Landscape authorities.
translated: Der Zugang zum Llŷn Coast Path ist in der Regel über öffentliche Wegerechte geöffnet, obwohl lokale Segmente saisonales Management haben können.
